lines.text: Musa grew up in Pharaoh's own palace, strong and wise.
lines.spoken: Musa grew up in Pharaoh's own palace, strong and wise.

lines.text: One day in the city, he found two men fighting.
lines.spoken: One day in the city, he found two men fighting.

lines.text: He struck the Egyptian once, and the man fell dead.
lines.spoken: He struck the Egyptian once, and the man fell dead.

lines.text: Musa turned to Allah: My Lord, I have wronged myself, forgive me.
lines.spoken: Musa turned to Allah: My Lord, I have wronged myself, forgive me.

lines.text: Then a man came running: the chiefs are plotting to kill you. Leave!
lines.spoken: Then a man came running: the chiefs are plotting to kill you. Leave!

lines.text: So Musa fled alone, into the desert, toward Madyan.
lines.spoken: So Musa fled alone, into the desert, toward Mad-yan.

lines.text: What waited for him at the well of Madyan? Follow for Part 3.
lines.spoken: What waited for him at the well of Mad-yan? Follow for Part three.
